Covers southern New York, New Jersey, Maryland and part of Virginia. Shows major roads, rivers and place names. Relief shown by hachures and form lines. Watercolor (blue). Imperfect: brittle, darkened and mounted on cloth with losses along bottom border. Annoations made in red on verso. Evans no 23104. Includes text, view of part of a canal with locks, and 3 section of lock diagrams that explain water regulation. Wheat, J.C.
